Name: HeartBloom - Heart Event Tracker
Author: HoangTuDaa18
Description:
[quote][center][color=#1e84cc][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Overview[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[/quote][b][color=#d5a6bd]HeartBloom[/color][/b] is a quality-of-life mod that helps players discover and track NPC Heart Events directly from [color=#ff7700][b]Stardew Valley's[/b][/color] Social Menu.
It adds small heart indicators next to NPC names, allowing players to quickly identify NPCs with Heart Events and check which events they can access based on their current friendship levels.
[color=#d5a6bd][size=4][b]HeartBloom[/b][/size][/color][b] [color=#ff7700]does not add new events, modify existing events, or automatically trigger them.[/color][/b] It simply makes discovering and tracking existing Heart Events more convenient.
[img width=510]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55446/55446-1794497367-777205758.png[/img]
[quote][center][color=#1e84cc][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Features[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[/quote][list]
[*][b][color=#d5a6bd]Heart Indicators:[/color][/b] Small heart icons appear next to NPC names with Heart Events.[/*]
[*][b][color=#d5a6bd]Hover Tooltips:[/color][/b] Hover over a heart to preview the lowest-heart unseen event you've met the friendship requirements for, including its location.[/*]
[*][b][color=#d5a6bd]Event List:[/color][/b] Click a heart to browse available Heart Events, including their friendship requirements, locations, and time information.[/*]
[*][b][color=#d5a6bd]Seen Event Tracking:[/color][/b] Easily distinguish between seen and unseen events.[/*]
[*][b][color=#d5a6bd]Hide Seen Events:[/color][/b] Optionally hide events you've already watched to keep the list clean.[/*]
[*][b][color=#d5a6bd]Additional Conditions:[/color][/b] Events with extra requirements are marked with an asterisk (*).[/*]
[*][b][color=#d5a6bd]Mod Compatibility:[/color][/b] Supports compatible Heart Events added by other NPC and location mods.[/*]
[*][b][color=#d5a6bd]Spoiler-Free:[/color][/b] HeartBloom only notifies you of Heart Events once you've met their friendship requirements.[/*]
[/list][quote][center][b][color=#93c47d][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS]Bug Fixes & Thanks[/font][/size][/color][/b][/center]
[/quote]
Check the Changelog for the latest fixes and improvements. Thanks to everyone who uses HeartBloom, reports bugs, and shares feedback. Your support means a lot!
[quote][center][b][color=#ff7700][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS]Installation[/font][/size][/color][/b][/center]
[/quote][heading]How?[/heading]
[list]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Install SMAPI (version 4.0.0 or later)[/color][/b] if you haven't already.[/*]
[*][b]Download HeartBloom[/b] and extract the downloaded ZIP file.[/*]
[*]Move the
[code]HeartBloom[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through [color=#ff7700][b]SMAPI.[/b][/color][/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b][/url] to configure HeartBloom directly in-game.[/*]
[/list]That's it! [b][color=#d5a6bd]HeartBloom[/color][/b] is ready to use.
[b]Note:[/b] Make sure the folder structure looks like this:
[code]Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
    └── HeartBloom/
        ├── i18n/
        ├── HeartBloom.dll
        └── manifest.json[/code][center]
